messages:
Leah (sales): Heads-up 1000 1000NovaBank procurement emailed asking for SOC2 artifacts, pen-test confirmation, and a 1-paragraph ISO statement. They want delivery via our secure portal after NDA. Can security/legal confirm what we can publish? Deadline: next Tue 04/05.
Tom (AE): Also can we confirm whether Dedicated subscription covers the audit-support work or if we need a billable engagement? Customer flagged it as a gating item for procurement.
Priya (SE): I can put together a redacted network diagram and short KMS/encryption statement. Quick question: do we have an official template for the "ISO statement" or should I draft a brief summary referring to ISO 27001 control families we cover?
Alex (Security): We can provide: (a) SOC 2 cover page + auditor & period, (b) pen-test confirmation letter (third-party vendor, date, scope, high/critical findings statement). ISO statement should be high-level only 1000no control-level detail.
Maya (Legal): Confirming process: SOC 2 full report requires executed NDA with limited use. We can send the SOC cover page via portal without NDA. Pen-test letter requires Legal to approve the text. No raw vuln data or logs.
Jordan (Customer): Procurement prefers portal link. They also asked if the Dedicated plan includes onsite audit support or if that's a separate SOW.
Tom (AE): Product note: Dedicated includes tenant isolation and baseline audit reports. Onsite or deep-dive audit assistance is a professional services add-on. I'll note that in the quote and propose an optional SOW.
Leah (sales): Action items: Priya to draft artifacts; Alex to draft pen-test letter; Maya to prepare NDA template and review pen-test wording; Tom to update quote language. We'll aim to share the portal link once NDA is signed.
Priya (SE): Draft checklist I'm starting: 
```
- SOC 2 cover page (auditor, date range)
- Pen-test confirmation letter (scope, date, high/critical findings summary)
- ISO statement (1 paragraph)
- Encryption at rest + KMS integration blurb
- Redacted network diagram (no IPs)
- Data retention & deletion statement
```
Priya (SE): ETA: I'll upload draft artifacts to the portal staging folder by tomorrow noon.
Alex (Security): Drafting pen-test letter now. Note: last third-party test 2025-08-18. If procurement needs tests within 6 months we can provide an internal vulnerability scan summary.
Maya (Legal): I'll draft an NDA with an exhibit limiting use to procurement review and include instructions for portal access. ETA tomorrow morning.
PortalBot: Reminder scheduled 1000follow-up with customer on 1796120300 (tomorrow 09:30 PT).
Tom (AE): Jordan (Customer) 1000can you confirm who on your side will sign NDA and whether procurement requires additional compliance forms (e.g., vendor risk questionnaire)?
Jordan (Customer): I'll confirm signatory today. They will likely also push a vendor risk questionnaire. Can Redwood provide a contact to complete that?
Leah (sales): Use security@redwood.com as primary contact for questionnaires. Priya, please include that contact in the packet.
Priya (SE): Will do. Adding the contact and a short "how to request more" note.
Alex (Security): Once pen-test letter draft is up, I'll tag Maya for sign-off. Avoiding technical details that could be used for exploitation.
Maya (Legal): Agreed. I'll review and sign once tagged.
Leah (sales): Thanks team. I'll keep procurement looped and only share portal link after NDA executed. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Customer): Thanks all, looking forward to the portal link and the quote update.
